chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Abu Khalid al-Qammat, from Abu al-Hasan al-Attar who said:
I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: 'Participation has been established between the successors (Imams) and the Messengers with regards to obedience.'

key_terms.أُشْرِكَ: passive form of 'sharing/participation'; here meaning 'made equal participants' in obedience — not in prophethood
key_terms.الرُّسُل: rasul (pl. rusul) — Messengers; prophets specifically sent with a revealed scripture and law
key_terms.الطَّاعَة: obedience; the duty of submission to divinely appointed authority
key_terms.الْأَوْصِيَاءِ: awsiya (sing. wasiy) — those designated as executors or successors; in Shia theology, the twelve Imams

ai.seo_question: Does obedience to the Imams carry the same weight as obedience to the Prophets in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes a creedal principle of Shia Islam: obedience to the Imams (awsiya) is coextensive with obedience to the Prophets and Messengers. This teaching was addressed to the Shia community of Kufa, where clarifying the spiritual and legal authority of the Imams was paramount, particularly in distinguishing the Imami position from those who limited authority to the Prophet alone. The hadith echoes Quranic injunctions (4:59, 4:80) commanding obedience to Allah, the Messenger, and those in authority.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Abu Khalid Al Qammat, from Abu Al Hassan Al Attar who said,
‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘There is a participation between the successors<sup>as</sup> and the Rasools<sup>as</sup> with regards to the obedience’.
en.sarwar: 5. A number of our people has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Sinan from abu Khalid al-Qammat from abu al_hassan al-‘Attar who has said that
he heard Imam abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) saying, “Of the matters common among the successors and the messengers themselves one is that to obey them all is obligatory.”
